problem: Ten servers expose too many tools, wrong schemas and incompatible versions.
principle: The host selects tools per task, adapts schemas to model APIs, authorizes calls and feeds observations back. A provider tool API is not MCP.
solutions: Filter by tenant/task and load lazily
Map definitions and correlate call IDs
check: Should a changing request ID also identify a retried business effect?
answer: No. A request ID correlates one exchange; operation_id must stay stable across side-effect retries.
